The cost of food
The cost of gas 
The cost of housing
The cost of everything 
Is being driven by this: ⬇️

An illegal war in the Middle East that is now driving oil and gas shortages, which has claimed the lives of U.S. service members, thousands of civilians, and nearly 170 school children and teachers. 

Donald Trump has not only brought economic suffering to millions of Americans, he has crossed our allies, weakened our national security, and brought shame to our country. 

Tuesday night the house voted against his illegal war again. Yesterday the Speaker shut down the House. We will not be silenced. We will continue to organize and mobilize and do the work until it is over!
